NETUOWID1..27characters; QUALIFIER0..255characters; QUALLEN halfword0..255; RESOURCE1..255characters; RESLEN halfword1..255; UOW16bytes with final8null bytes; TASKID4-byte packed decimal; TRANSID1..4characters. UOW/RESOURCE/RESLEN/ENQSCOPE are START inputs or NEXT outputs, not simultaneous direction in a single form.

Supplemental UOWENQ149-234: RELATION OWNER/WAITER; STATE ACTIVE/RETAINED; TYPE DATASET/EXECENQ/EXECENQADDR/FILE/TDQUEUE/TSQUEUE. DATASET refers to VSAM non-RLS or CICS-maintained table, with dataset RESOURCE and record QUALIFIER; VSAM owns RLS locking. EXECENQ resource is argument bytes; EXECENQADDR is address enqueue (LENGTH omitted). FILE identifies BDAM/user-maintained table; BDAM qualifier includes block ID, truncating combined data above255characters. TDQUEUE resource names logically recoverable queue with FROMQ/TOQ qualifier; READQ owns FROMQ, WRITEQ TOQ, DELETEQ both. TSQUEUE resource names recoverable TS and has no qualifier. EXECENQ/EXECENQADDR/TSQUEUE QUALLEN0. These namespaces cannot be normalized from labels alone.

Supplemental UOWENQ31-106: START may filter UOW, RESOURCE+RESLEN or ENQSCOPE; blank ENQSCOPE selects local. Unfiltered browse considers one UOW at a time, owner then its waiters before next owned enqueue; no defined global order/start point. START returns no first item. Browse does not lock state between NEXT calls; changed owner may cause same enqueue to return again. Only local owners/waiters are returned even for sysplex enqueues. Both UOW/task lifetimes occur, with documented indoubt TASK-lifetime exception before end-of-task syncpoint.
